act_title: The Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006
title: Penalty for unhygienic or unsanitary processing or manufacturing of food
text:
56. Penalty for unhygienic or unsanitary processing or manufacturing of food.—Any person

who, whether by himself or by any other person on his behalf, manufactures or processes any article of
food for human consumption under unhygienic or unsanitary conditions, shall be liable to a penalty which
may extend to one lakh rupees.

-----
